settings.title: Azure Capacity Study Dashboard (Project 24CC3046-P056)
settings.subtitle: Microsoft Azure Cloud Load Testing & Performance Optimization
settings.content:
## Project ID: 24CC3046-P056 — Azure Load Testing for a Web Application Capacity Study

### All 8 Core Azure Services In This Project:
1. **Azure App Service**: `app-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Hosts eCommerce Application)
2. **App Service Plan**: `asp-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Standard S1 Compute Resource)
3. **Azure Load Testing**: `alt-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Runs JMeter Multi-Threaded Tests)
4. **Application Insights**: `appi-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Request, Latency & Error Telemetry)
5. **Azure Monitor**: Metrics collection & alerting across all compute resources
6. **Azure Autoscale**: `autoscale-asp-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Scale-out at CPU > 70%, Scale-in at CPU < 30%)
7. **Azure Database for PostgreSQL**: Flexible Server `psql-capacity-study-363acfoagthui`
8. **Log Analytics Workspace**: `law-capacity-study-363acfoagthui` (Centralized Log Aggregation)

**Live App URL:** https://app-capacity-study-363acfoagthui.azurewebsites.net

settings.title: Capacity Study Test Matrix & Breaking Point Findings
settings.content:
| Test Run | Virtual Users | Requests | RPS | Avg Latency | P95 Latency | App CPU % | Threshold Status |
|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|:---:|
| **Run 1: Baseline** | 10 | 39,129 | 130.4 | 69.6 ms | 258.0 ms | 23.0% | **PASS** |
| **Run 2: Step Load 1** | 50 | 38,878 | 129.6 | 70.0 ms | 229.0 ms | 38.0% | **PASS** |
| **Run 3: Step Load 2** | 100 | 35,415 | 118.1 | 76.8 ms | 251.0 ms | 52.0% | **PASS** |
| **Run 4: Elevated** | 250 | 35,033 | 116.8 | 77.7 ms | 250.0 ms | 68.0% | **PASS** |
| **Run 5: Breaking Point** | 500 | 32,958 | 109.9 | 82.6 ms | 272.0 ms | **80.0%** | **CPU THRESHOLD BREACH** |

> **Observed Safe Limit:** 250 Concurrent Virtual Users on Standard S1.
> **Breaking Point:** At 500 Virtual Users, CPU reached the configured 80% boundary.
